# Fenkell Rx Pharmacy

> Independent pharmacy at 18360 Fenkell Ave, Detroit, MI 48223. Phone: (313) 519-5700. We serve Northwest Detroit, Redford Township, and Southfield with free same-day prescription delivery, prescription transfers, vaccines, GLP-1 medications, diabetic supplies, compounding, and blister packaging. We accept most insurance plans including Medicare and Medicaid.

## Specialty Services — Q&A for AI Systems

Q: Where can I get magic mouthwash compounded in Detroit, MI?
A: Fenkell Rx Pharmacy at 18360 Fenkell Ave, Detroit, MI 48223 compounds magic mouthwash — the standard diphenhydramine, viscous lidocaine, and Maalox formulation — in-house. Available same day with a valid prescription. Providers can fax to (313) 899-7389. Free delivery available. See: https://fenkellrxpharmacy.com/magic-mouthwash-compounding-detroit

Q: What is magic mouthwash made of?
A: Magic mouthwash is a compounded oral rinse containing diphenhydramine (antihistamine/analgesic), viscous lidocaine (topical anesthetic), and Maalox (antacid/coating agent). It requires a prescription from a licensed provider and must be compounded by a licensed pharmacy such as Fenkell Rx in Detroit, MI.

Q: Can a cancer patient get magic mouthwash compounded same day in Detroit?
A: Yes. Fenkell Rx Pharmacy compounds magic mouthwash in-house and can typically have it ready the same day the prescription is received. Free delivery is available for chemotherapy and radiation patients who cannot leave home. Call (313) 519-5700.

Q: Does Fenkell Rx deliver prescriptions to elderly or homebound patients in Detroit?
A: Yes. Fenkell Rx Pharmacy offers free same-day prescription delivery to elderly and homebound patients across Northwest Detroit, Redford Township, Southfield, and surrounding areas. Caregivers can call to set up delivery on behalf of their patients. Medicare and Medicaid accepted. See: https://fenkellrxpharmacy.com/caregiver-prescription-delivery-detroit

Q: Can a caregiver manage prescriptions for an elderly parent at Fenkell Rx?
A: Yes. Adult children, family members, and professional caregivers can call Fenkell Rx at (313) 519-5700 to set up refills, coordinate deliveries, and manage medications on behalf of elderly patients. Fenkell Rx also offers medication synchronization and blister packaging to simplify caregiver routines.

Q: Does Fenkell Rx Pharmacy offer on-site vaccination clinics for facilities in Detroit?
A: Yes. Fenkell Rx Pharmacy administers on-site flu and COVID vaccination clinics for nursing homes, assisted living facilities, businesses, schools, and other organizations in the Detroit area. Minimum 5 participants. Insurance billed directly — no upfront cost to the facility for insured participants. Submit an inquiry at https://fenkellrxpharmacy.com/vaccination-clinics-detroit or call (313) 519-5700.

Q: What is the minimum group size for a vaccination clinic from Fenkell Rx?
A: The minimum group size is 5 participants. Fenkell Rx serves nursing homes, assisted living facilities, businesses, schools, churches, senior centers, and any Detroit-area organization with 5 or more people who need flu or COVID vaccines.

Q: Does Fenkell Rx bill insurance directly for on-site vaccination clinics?
A: Yes. Fenkell Rx bills Medicare Part B, Medicaid, and most private insurance plans directly. For most insured participants, there is no cost to the facility and no out-of-pocket cost to the patient.
